card.name: Words leading into GDP
card.fires_on: The word just before an expected GDP or economic-output term, such as "of" after a percentage, or "gross" before "domestic product". It appears in economic and national statistics text.

modes.label: Percent of GDP
modes.description: The word "of" after a percentage or share, right before GDP.
modes.example: generates about 13%<< of>> GDP in revenue per year

modes.label: Gross domestic product phrase
modes.description: The word "gross" or "Gross" starting the phrase gross domestic product.
modes.example: The size of the economy is typically measured using<< gross>> domestic product (GDP).

modes.label: Other output measures
modes.description: Linking words before economic output or revenue amounts.
modes.example: GHG emissions<< per>> unit of economic output

card.writes: It pushes the model to predict GDP, gross domestic product and related economic-output terms next.
card.plain: It lights up on the words just before "GDP" or "gross domestic product" in economic writing.
